- Pilot duration: you asked about a 60-day runway; we can accommodate but I need to size credits appropriately.

If you prefer, send over the last 7-day token usage CSV and I can run a burn-rate calc and propose a credit amount. I’ve CC'd Vivek (sales engineering) so we can coordinate an optimization/architecture check to lower unit spend early.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with an internal ask once I have your numbers.
